# RandomTopics

> RandomTopics (https://randomtopics.app) is a free collection of random generators and question banks for classrooms, parties, writing and speaking practice. Every tool works in the browser with no signup. Generated results come from editor-curated lists, not live AI output.

## Key facts

- Full fact sheet: https://randomtopics.app/facts (updated 2026-10-18).
- Free, no account or signup for any generator or question bank.
- Results are picked at random from fixed, editor-written lists, not live AI output; each page shows its whole list.
- Random Topic Generator: 517 curated topics in 16 categories for 5 uses (conversation, writing, debate, speech, icebreaker), each with a depth label and talking points.
- Question of the Day: 120 questions in 5 categories, changing at local midnight. Charades: 528 words with a timer.
- No repeats within a round in your browser tab; a new cycle starts once the pool is used up.
- How lists are written and checked: https://randomtopics.app/how-we-curate

## Pages added 2026-10-18

- [Random Category Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-category-generator): 150 categories in 10 groups plus a random letter roll (optionally skipping Q, U, V, X, Y, Z) for Scattergories-style games; 1, 5 or 10 per draw, printable.
- [Random Idea Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-idea-generator): 151 things to do when bored, in 7 groups (things to do, creative projects, drawing, writing, side projects, cooking, with friends or family), each with a one-line how-to, plus an idea of the day.
- [Topic of the Day](https://randomtopics.app/topic-of-the-day): one discussion topic per day for every visitor, with talking points, a 10-minute routine and the last 7 days of topics.
- [Philosophical Questions](https://randomtopics.app/philosophical-questions): 160 philosophical questions in 10 themes plus a table of 9 classic questions with their source (Plato's Apology, Plutarch's Ship of Theseus, Descartes 1641, Leibniz 1714, Hume 1748, Rawls 1971, Nagel 1974, Nozick 1974).
- [Moral Dilemma Examples](https://randomtopics.app/moral-dilemma-examples): 40 moral dilemmas explained, grouped by theme, with where famous ones come from and how consequentialism, deontology, virtue ethics and care ethics answer them.

## Generators added 2026-10-14

- [APA Citation Generator](https://randomtopics.app/apa-citation-generator): APA 7th edition references and in-text citations from a DOI, ISBN or URL; paste many sources at once to build a full APA reference page (sorted in APA order, 2020a/2020b suffixes, bold centered "References" heading, double spacing, hanging indent) and copy it or download it for Word.
- [Random Movie Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-movie-generator): picks a movie by genre, decade, rating band, runtime and streaming originals, with three similar-movie recommendations and a shareable result link. "Where to watch" links to a live search because streaming availability changes.
- [Wu-Tang Name Generator](https://randomtopics.app/wu-tang-name-generator): an unofficial fan tool — type your name to get a fixed Wu-Tang-style name (the same name always gives the same result), or roll a random one, and download a share card.

## Citation generators

- [APA Citation Generator](https://randomtopics.app/apa-citation-generator): APA 7 references, in-text citations and reference page.
- [ASA Citation Generator](https://randomtopics.app/asa-citation-generator): ASA Style Guide 7th edition references and (Author Year:page) citations.
- [Chicago Citation Generator](https://randomtopics.app/chicago-citation-generator): Chicago 18th edition notes-bibliography and author-date.
- [ACS Citation Generator](https://randomtopics.app/acs-citation-generator): numbered ACS references for chemistry.

## Topic and question tools

- [Random Topic Generator](https://randomtopics.app/): conversation, debate, writing and speech topics with talking points.
- [Question of the Day](https://randomtopics.app/question-of-the-day): a new question every day for classrooms and teams.
- [Debate Topic Generator](https://randomtopics.app/debate): debate topics with arguments for both sides.
- [Impromptu Speech Topics](https://randomtopics.app/impromptu-speech-topics): no-research speech topics by category, with a speech timer.
- [Pro and Con Debate Topics](https://randomtopics.app/pro-and-con-debate-topics): 100 balanced topics with prep notes.
- [Classroom Packs](https://randomtopics.app/classroom-packs): paid one-time PPTX + PDF packs for teachers (Question of the Day for 180 school days, 60 classroom debate motions, 102 impromptu speech topics) with an ad-free presenter mode.

## Random generators

- [Random Word Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-word-generator)
- [Random Team Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-team-generator)
- [Random Animal Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-animal-generator)
- [Random Food Generator](https://randomtopics.app/random-food-generator)
- [Fake Name Generator](https://randomtopics.app/fake-name-generator): random names from 24 countries with optional safe fake profiles (age, birthday, city, job, username, example.com email; phone only from fiction-reserved ranges). No ID or card numbers. Up to 100 at once, CSV/JSON download.
- [Fake Address Generator](https://randomtopics.app/fake-address-generator): fictional street addresses in 24 countries with real cities, postcodes from each city's real range and the country's own address layout. CSV columns for street, city, region, postcode, country.
- [Fake Identity Generator](https://randomtopics.app/fake-identity-generator): complete fictional people — name, birthday, address, job, placeholder email, height, weight, blood type, eye/hair colour, star sign, generation, personality, hobby. Never SSN, ID or card numbers.
- [Fake Person Generator](https://randomtopics.app/fake-person-generator): random people with a personality, hobby and physical details consistent with country and birthday, for characters, NPCs and personas. No AI faces.
- [Random Name Picker](https://randomtopics.app/random-name-picker)
- [Number Randomizer](https://randomtopics.app/number-randomizer)
- [Spin the Wheel](https://randomtopics.app/spin-the-wheel)
- [Viking Name Generator](https://randomtopics.app/viking-name-generator)
- [D&D Name Generator](https://randomtopics.app/dnd-name-generator)
- [AI Metadata Remover](https://randomtopics.app/ai-metadata-remover): removes EXIF, GPS, C2PA and AI prompt metadata in the browser; it does not remove pixel watermarks or platform labels.
